verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform. Automation features such as triggers are a fair axis for it, but the evidence pack never documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The shutdown notice also says the API, Connect, Toolbox, and CLI stopped working and that there is no longer a documented surface to version.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
